summary: - iii. _Pass any other or further order which this Hon’ble Commission may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of this case._ - j. The Petitioner has placed on record the information/ documents regarding the entire Bidding/ Tendering process, along with the Notification regarding the constitution of the Bid opening and evaluation committee. The Petitioner has also submitted copies of the standard PPA and PSA (issued along with the RfS document), including the Bid Evaluation Reports (techno-commercial evaluation report dated 06.01.2026, Financial Evaluation report dated 09.01.2025 and e-reverse auction report dated 12.01.2026). The copy of the bid results after the e-reverse auction, along with copies of the Conformity Certificates, are also submitted with the Petition. Letters of Award dated 29.01.2026 issued by SECI to the successful bidders were also placed on record. 4. The Petitioner reiterated its submissions regarding the adoption of the tariff. After hearing counsel for the Petitioner, the Commission admitted the petition and directed the issuance of notice to the Respondents. The Commission directed the Respondents to file their replies, if any, within two weeks with a copy to the Petitioner, who may file its rejoinder, if any, within two weeks thereafter. 6. The Petitioner submitted that the notice was issued to the Respondents, allowing them to file their replies as part of compliance with the ROP dated 16.04.2026. The Petitioner further submitted that, pursuant to the Commission’s issuance of notice, only Respondent No. 2 (NLCIL) has filed its reply, supporting its prayers and requesting expeditious adoption of the tariff. After hearing the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the Commission reserved the matter for order. - xix. _Dispute resolution is subject to the Appropriate Commission, CERC, or SERC/ JERC. If difficulties arise in giving effect to any provision of these Guidelines or interpretation of the Guidelines, the Ministry of Power is empowered to do so with the approval of the Minister, New & Renewable Energy. Renewable energy components, including Energy Storage System (ESS) components charged with RE sources, are eligible for RPO compliance._ 12. In terms of the provisions of Section 63 of the Act, the Commission has to examine whether the process outlined in the Guidelines has been followed in the present case to arrive at the lowest tariff for the selection of the successful bidder. Accordingly, after conclusion of the e-Reverse Auction process, on 29.01.2026, the Petitioner issued Letters of Award (LoAs) to the Selected Bidders as under: _1.5 In case of the Successful Bidder itself executing the PPA, it shall ensure that its promoters shall not cede control (Control shall mean the ownership, directly or indirectly, of more than 50% of the voting shares of such Company or right to appoint majority Directors) of the Bidding Company/Consortium until 01 (one) year after the SCSD, except with the prior approval of SECI._ _1.14 In case, the SECI offers to execute the PPA with the SPD and the selected Bidder refuses to execute the PPA within the stipulated time period, then the Bank Guarantee equivalent to the amount of the EMD shall be encashed by SECI from the Bank Guarantee available with SECI (i.e. EMD or PBG) as penalty, the selected Project shall stand cancelled, and the selected Bidder expressly waives off its rights and objections, if any, in that respect._ _1.18 All disputes arising out of and/ or in connection with the selection of Solar Power Projects under the said RfS and execution of PPA thereto shall be governed by laws of India and shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Courts of New Delhi._ 19. The Petitioner SECI has also submitted Conformity Certificates, as required under Clause 11.2 of the Guidelines dated 09.06.2023, certifying that no deviations were made from the Guidelines in the Request for Selection (RfS) documents and that the Bid Evaluation Committee (BEC) has conducted the bid evaluation in conformity with the provisions of the RfS document. The adoption of the tariff as above is subject to signing the PSA with the distribution licensees. As soon as the awarded capacity is tied up under the PPAs and PSAs, the Petitioner shall place on record the copies of such PPAs and PSAs. Also, if the awarded capacity does not fructify into the PPAs and PSAs, the Petitioner shall also place on record such development(s) in the file of the present case.
title: Petition under Section 63 of the Electricity Act, 2003 for adoption of tariff for 1200 MW Inter-State Transmission System (ISTS)- connected Solar PV Power Projects with 600 MW/ 3600 MWh Energy Storage Systems (ESS) and selected through competitive bidding process (SECI-ISTS-XXI) as per the guidelines of the Government of India.
